mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops > 1% MoM and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over three months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% over 3 months and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflation scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by > 300,000 and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops > 10% MoM and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE is rising, and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.
